title: WPMB/626/2001 of ALOK SHARDA and ORS. Vs STATE and ORS.

paras.text:
Court No. 2
Withdrawal Application no. 24 of 2003
 in
Writ Petition No. 626 (M/B) of 2001
Alok Sharda and others ............... Petitioner
 Vs.
State OF Uttaranchal and others................. Respondent
 ......
Hon. P. C. Verma, A.C.J.
Hon. Irshad Hussain, J.
Heard Sri Sharad Sharma, learned counsel for the
applicants/petitioners. Sri L.P.Naithani and Sri B.P. Nautiyal, learned
counsel for the interveners.
This is an application for the withdrawal of the writ petition, which
has been filed by the petitioner against the cancellation of the auction dated
1.6.2001. This Court on 12.06.2001 by interim order provided that the
second auction may be held but the same shall not be finalized.
In view of the participation in the auction, both the petitioners as
well as interveners have deposited their security money. Now, the question
arises as to whose security money should be forfeited and whose security
money should be refunded. Obviously, the writ petition was filed by the
petitioner challenging the second auction and now he seeks permission to
withdraw the writ petition. Therefore, it was because of the petitioner that
the security money of the interveners was got held up with the respondent
authorities. The permission to withdraw the writ petition is granted. The
security of the interveners shall be refunded and the concerned authority
shall proceed for fresh auction, if required, in accordance with rules.
So far as the security money of the petitioners is concerned, the
authorities are directed to take decision in accordance with rules.
Subject to above, the application is disposed of.
 (Irshad Hussain,J.) (P.C. Verma, A.C.J.)
Dt. 9.4.2003
 A
